You are a professional biblical lexicographer fluent in Spanish. Translate the following English lexicon entry into Spanish.

Lemma: H4970

ENGLISH GLOSSES TO TRANSLATE:
  Terse gloss: "When? — interrogative adverb of time, often in the urgent cry 'how long?' (ad-matay)"
  Readable gloss: "An interrogative adverb asking 'when?' with respect to future time. Standing alone it voices a speaker's impatience or longing — 'When shall I arise?' (Job 7:4), 'When will you do something for my household too?' (Gen 30:30). Combined with the preposition 'ad ('until'), it becomes the anguished refrain 'how long?' echoing through the psalms of lament (Ps 74:10; 82:2; 94:3) and prophetic rebuke (1 Kgs 18:21). This particle captures one of Scripture's most emotionally charged questions: the cry of the suffering for divine intervention."

SENSES:
  Sense 1: "when"
    Enriched: Interrogative 'when?' for future time. Alone it asks a simple question (Gen 30:30; Neh 2:6); with le- it means 'by when?' (Exod 8:5). In the compound 'ad-matay it becomes the lament cry 'how long?' (Ps 74:10; 94:3). French 'quand' and Spanish 'cuándo' mirror the bare form, while English 'how long' captures the 'ad-matay construction.
    Existing Spanish translations: cuándo, cuándo?, ¿Cuándo, ¿cuándo?
